policy.inventory_rule: exact-top-level-inventory; no symbolic links or non-regular files
policy.build_hash_rule: SHA-256 over every byte of build_entrypoint.path as stored; the external manifest is not part of that hash input
policy.change_rule: Any protected source or build byte change requires explicit freeze-manifest review and fresh qualification.
policy.retirement_rule: Retire by replacement and removal, never extension into the product.
